name: worktable
description: Build shared Docs, live HTML workspaces, structured Records, annotations, and durable agent threads in Worktable.

interface.longDescription: Worktable gives ChatGPT and your other agents one durable workspace for private Docs, interactive HTML Docs, structured Records, drawings, annotations, and threaded handoffs. Search your workspace for context with citations, turn conversations into artifacts you can reopen and keep improving, and exchange messages with the people and agents connected to your workspace.
defaultPrompt: Turn this into a polished interactive Worktable HTML Doc.
Organize this research as reusable Worktable records.
Check my Worktable messages and respond.

positive.description: Answer from workspace knowledge with citations
positive.prompt: What do our Worktable notes and records say about the Atlas launch date, owner, readiness bar, and milestones? Cite the relevant Worktable items.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches Worktable, fetches the Atlas launch brief and the launch milestone Records, and answers that Maya Chen owns the October 15, 2026 launch, the readiness bar is 99.95% uptime and 25 active beta customers, and the milestones are Security review (Done), Billing rehearsal (In progress), and Public launch (Planned). Each fact cites an openable Worktable link. No content is created or changed.

positive.description: Build a live dashboard from existing workspace content
positive.prompt: Turn the Atlas launch brief and milestones into a polished live Worktable dashboard with the launch date, readiness bar, owners, milestone status, and links back to the source items.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the Atlas launch brief and milestone Records, then creates one interactive HTML Doc in the Atlas Launch Space that shows the launch date, readiness bar, owners, and milestone status with links to the source items. Replies with the new HTML Doc's Worktable link instead of pasting raw HTML.

positive.prompt: Create a reusable Vendor Research collection in the Atlas Launch space from these candidates: Northstar, evaluation, Maya, SSO and audit logs; Acme, contacted, Omar, strong API but no SCIM; Juniper, shortlisted, Priya, best security review. Use fields for stage, owner, and notes, then verify the saved records.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a Vendor Research collection with stage, owner, and notes fields, saves exactly three Records that keep every supplied detail, queries the collection to verify them, and reports the collection and the verified record count.

positive.description: Leave a review instruction without editing the document
positive.prompt: Add a Worktable instruction to the Atlas launch brief asking the team to verify the pricing assumptions. Do not edit the brief itself.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the Atlas launch brief and adds one open instruction annotation attached to its Pricing assumptions section. The brief's text is unchanged. Replies with confirmation and a link to the brief.

positive.description: Make a precise edit to an existing Doc
positive.prompt: In the Atlas launch brief, add a Risks section that says the billing rehearsal is still in progress and could delay the October 15 launch. Keep everything else in the brief unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the Atlas launch brief, then adds a Risks section describing the in-progress billing rehearsal and its possible effect on the October 15 launch. All existing content is preserved. Replies with a link to the updated brief.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Self-contained calculation with nothing to save
Summary that the user did not ask to save
negative.prompt: Summarize this paragraph in one sentence: Atlas is a fictional product launch used only to test a plugin review flow.

publication.release_notes: Adds bundled Worktable skills for finding context, writing Docs, building interactive HTML Docs, organizing Records, reviewing with annotations, and collaborating in threads. Completes the listing metadata, including the support page.
